assay_run.assay_type: Endpoint β-catenin and TOPFlash fluorescence imaging
assay_run.method: Original-screen aggregate of the HEK293T Wnt I/O frequency series at 55% duty cycle. Endpoint tdmRuby3–β-catenin and TOPFlash–tdIRFP fluorescence was measured after 48 h of LITOS stimulation. Figure 3B–E reports four biological replicates per condition. Repository content: study-level numerical data and plotting code. The archived Zenodo record classifies this resource as software (computational notebook).
assay_run.platform: Nikon W2 SoRa spinning-disk confocal microscope; LITOS stimulation device

assay_run.method: Rearranged replicate LITOS screen aggregate for the selected 55% duty-cycle frequency series. Figure 3—figure supplement 1H reports the replicate TopFlash endpoint. The sample IDs represent frequency conditions. Individual replicate and acquisition identities are unspecified.
assay_run.platform: Nikon W2 SoRa spinning-disk confocal microscope; LITOS stimulation device
